title: Aromatic Dense Turkish Sardines Kunefe
description: A herbal and dense Turkish dish featuring sardines in a kunefe form, wrapped in ti leaves, perfect for a comforting meal. It combines Mediterranean flavors with the richness of sardines and the crunch of kunefe.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the chopped sardines, minced garlic, lemon juice, chopped parsley, salt, and black pepper.
Lay a ti leaf flat on a work surface and place a quarter of the kunefe dough in the center of the leaf.
Spoon a quarter of the sardine mixture onto the center of the kunefe dough.
Fold the ti leaf over the filling to form a square package and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Brush the tops of the ti leaf packages with olive oil.
Place the packages in a baking dish and bake for 25 minutes or until the kunefe dough is golden brown.
Serve the Aromatic Dense Turkish Sardines Kunefe hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
